decisions.reason: The adjustable cardboard quarter pallet closely leverages the firm's existing paperboard converting knowledge, enabling effective learning and improvement.
Although the pegboard back introduces some non-paper material, the cardboard core still aligns with the firm's absorptive capacity.
This standard cardboard quarter-pallet display is well within the firm's paper-based knowledge base, supporting continued learning.
The cardboard eighth-pallet display builds on related paperboard display expertise, making it likely to be retained.
The wooden pallet is distant from the firm's paper and paperboard expertise, limiting its ability to assimilate and improve the product.
The cardboard media display leverages existing paperboard knowledge, though its niche media application adds some uncertainty.
